title: POST /v1/ping request
description: The anonymous install ping: sent once per install and once per upgrade in every telemetry mode, never under DO_NOT_TRACK. It carries no identifier, so two pings cannot be linked to each other or to an install. See CONTRACT.md.

plugin_version.description: A release version only: major.minor.patch with bounded digits. No pre-release or build suffix, because free text there could carry an identifier and every distinct value is a new ping_daily row.
